# MLflow feature compatibility matrix

<!-- Generated by `bun scripts/mlflow-matrix.ts --write` from
packages/tracking-mlflow/src/feature-matrix.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pinned MLflow: **3.17.2** (`packages/tracking-mlflow/env/uv.lock`). Criterion 18 (spec §15): every MLflow capability AblationKit relies on, the REST endpoints or Python APIs that provide it, where it is used in AblationKit, and the suites that run it against the pinned server. No row needs the stock MLflow UI, which AblationKit never links to, frames or proxies.

How it stays true:

- `bun test` (`packages/tracking-mlflow/test/feature-matrix.test.ts`) fails if the client calls an endpoint, or the bridge has an op, that no row lists; if a row lists an endpoint, op or Python API the code no longer uses; or if this page is stale.
- `bun run ci` runs the real-MLflow suites with `ABLATIONKIT_MLFLOW_TRACE` set, then `bun scripts/mlflow-matrix.ts --coverage` fails unless every endpoint and op below succeeded against the pinned server in that run.
- Bump the pin only with those suites passing (`AGENTS.md`).

## Server

| Feature | MLflow | AblationKit | Suites |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Health and version of the managed sidecar (upgrade guard) | `GET /health`<br>`GET /version` | Status bar, System page, `tracking doctor` | `test:mlflow`, `test:lifecycle`, `test:restore` |

## Experiments and runs

| Feature | MLflow | AblationKit | Suites |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Create, read, search, rename, delete, restore and tag experiments (`ak/<project-id>`) | `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/create`<br>`GET /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/get`<br>`GET /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/get-by-name`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/search`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/update`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/delete`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/restore`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/set-experiment-tag` | Experiments page, `tracking import` | `test:mlflow` |
| Create, read, update, search, delete and restore runs | `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/create`<br>`GET /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/get`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/update`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/search`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/delete`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/restore` | Runs, Studies and Compare pages; jobs | `test:mlflow`, `test:lifecycle` |
| Params, metrics, tags and system metrics in batches; tag edits | `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/log-batch`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/set-tag`<br>`POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/delete-tag` | Run detail (parameters, tags, system metrics); the job collector | `test:mlflow`, `test:lifecycle` |
| Full metric history for charts (downsampled in AblationKit) | `GET /api/2.0/mlflow/metrics/get-history` | Metric charts, comparisons and ablation tables | `test:mlflow`, `test:restore` |

## MLflow Projects

| Feature | MLflow | AblationKit | Suites |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MLproject` entrypoints and parameters, run as supervised jobs. AblationKit parses `MLproject` itself and runs the entrypoint as a job (no `mlflow run`); `docker_env` is refused. | `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/runs/create` | Runs → Entrypoints, `mlproject show\|run` | `test:lifecycle` |
